title: Physical Therapist Aides
description: Under close supervision of a physical therapist or physical therapy assistant, perform only delegated, selected, or routine tasks in specific situations. These duties include preparing the patient and the treatment area.

tasks.text: Clean and organize work area and disinfect equipment after treatment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of medical equipment

dwas.name: Clean patient rooms or patient treatment rooms.
Clean medical equipment.

tasks.text: Secure patients into or onto therapy equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically holding patients for positioning

dwas.name: Hold patients to ensure proper positioning or safety.

tasks.text: Instruct, motivate, safeguard, or assist patients practicing exercises or functional activities, under direction of medical staff.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live emotional encouragement of patients is human presence

dwas.name: Encourage patients during therapeutic activities.
Engage patients in exercises or activities.

tasks.text: Confer with physical therapy staff or others to discuss and evaluate patient information for planning, modifying, or coordinating treatment.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Care planning conferral is collaborative clinical judgment

dwas.name: Confer with other professionals to plan patient care.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Observe patients during treatment to compile and evaluate data on patients' responses and progress and report to physical therapist.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI aids chart review; clinical observation of patient is human

dwas.name: Monitor patient progress or responses to treatments.

tasks.text: Change linens, such as bed sheets and pillow cases.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning in patient care rooms

dwas.name: Clean patient rooms or patient treatment rooms.

tasks.text: Administer active or passive manual therapeutic exercises, therapeutic massage, or heat, light, sound, water, or electrical modality treatments, such as ultrasound.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on therapy application requires physical dexterity

dwas.name: Administer therapy treatments to patients using hands or physical treatment aids.

tasks.text: Transport patients to and from treatment areas, using wheelchairs or providing standing support.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Moving patients requires hands-on body handling

dwas.name: Move patients to or from treatment areas.

tasks.text: Perform clerical duties, such as taking inventory, ordering supplies, answering telephone, taking messages, or filling out forms.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Clerical medical paperwork aided; compliance review human

dwas.name: Perform clerical work in medical settings.
Inventory medical supplies or equipment.

tasks.text: Schedule patient appointments with physical therapists and coordinate therapists' schedules.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Clinical scheduling needs human verification of constraints

dwas.name: Schedule patient procedures or appointments.

tasks.text: Arrange treatment supplies to keep them in order.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on instrument preparation and sterilization

dwas.name: Prepare medical instruments or equipment for use.

tasks.text: Assist patients to dress, undress, or put on and remove supportive devices, such as braces, splints, or slings.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on patient daily activity assistance

dwas.name: Assist patients with daily activities.

tasks.text: Maintain equipment or furniture to keep it in good working condition, including performing the assembly or disassembly of equipment or accessories.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on instrument preparation and sterilization

dwas.name: Prepare medical instruments or equipment for use.
Maintain medical equipment or instruments.

tasks.text: Record treatment given and equipment used.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain records; human owns clinical accuracy

dwas.name: Maintain medical records.

tasks.text: Measure patient's range-of-joint motion, body parts, or vital signs to determine effects of treatments or for patient evaluations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical exam requires hands-on patient contact

dwas.name: Assess physical conditions of patients to aid in diagnosis or treatment.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Train patients to use orthopedic braces, prostheses, or supportive devices.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient medical-equipment teaching is hands-on clinical

dwas.name: Teach medical procedures or medical equipment use to patients.

tasks.text: Administer traction to relieve neck or back pain, using intermittent or static traction equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Basic health care treatments are hands-on patient work

dwas.name: Administer basic health care or medical treatments.

tasks.text: Fit patients for orthopedic braces, prostheses, or supportive devices, adjusting fit as needed.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Fitting assistive devices is hands-on physical customization

dwas.name: Fit patients for assistive devices.

tasks.text: Participate in patient care tasks, such as assisting with passing food trays, feeding residents, or bathing residents on bed rest.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on patient daily activity assistance

dwas.name: Assist patients with daily activities.
